`main.wj` is written and compiles with `wj build`. I ran it on `255 10 16`, `ZZ 36 2` and `0 7 3`, and it printed `FF`, `10100001111` and `0`, which match the expected outputs. I didn't run the `1010 2 10` line from example 2, or any large values near 2^63 - 1.

The program reads every line from stdin and converts the value to a number. It then writes that number in the target base with upper-case
